# Nine price blocks, each refused for what it states.
#
# What this fixture produces, on a book holding
# prices_of_a_currency_and_a_stock.txt: nothing. Every block is refused, with its
# reason, and the two prices the book holds are left as they are:
#
# - a USD rate whose value divides by zero;
# - a USD rate whose value is too large for GnuCash to store;
# - a USD rate dated a day that does not exist;
# - a USD rate whose time is neither a date nor a moment;
# - a rate in XYZ, which is no currency GnuCash knows;
# - a price stating a namespace and no mnemonic;
# - the NASDAQ:AMZN price, by its guid, stating another commodity;
# - a new USD rate with no value;
# - a USD rate whose guid is not a guid.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_price_block_is_refused_for_what_it_states.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-03-02"
	value: "1/0"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-03-03"
	value: "99999999999999999999"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-02-30"
	value: "1.36"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "yesterday"
	value: "1.36"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "XYZ"
	time: "2026-03-04"
	value: "1.36"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-03-05"
	value: "1.36"

price
	guid: "4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-03-06"

price
	guid: "not-a-guid"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-03-07"
	value: "1.36"
